en.headline: Four jailed over plots to steal Chanel goods worth HK$8.7 million
en.dek: The High Court sentenced four former warehouse workers to terms of up to seven years for conspiring to steal obsolete Chanel handbags and wallets from a Tsing Yi facility.
body: Four former warehouse workers were jailed for up to seven years on Monday for conspiring to steal more than 800 unsold Chanel handbags and wallets worth at least HK$8.7 million.

The High Court sentenced the defendants over two foiled plots targeting storage spaces used by the French fashion house at the Goodman Interlink warehouse in Tsing Yi between June 2016 and February 2017. The items were obsolete merchandise from the 2014-15 season that were awaiting disposal under Chanel’s policy of protecting product exclusivity.

Warehouse supervisor Ng Yiu-lun, 42, disclosed the password for a lift used by Chanel staff. Accomplices including Happy Ho Tung-shan, 35, and Ho Tsz-yin, 41, attempted to steal about 90 handbags in 2016 by hiding them instead of destroying them. Security later found the goods but did not initially report the matter to police. The second plot was also intercepted.

zh.headline: 四名前倉務員串謀盜竊Chanel貨品判囚最長七年
zh.dek: 高等法院周一判處四名前倉庫工人最高七年監禁，罪名是串謀從青衣貨倉盜竊價值至少870萬元的Chanel過季手袋及銀包。
body: 四名前倉庫工人周一因串謀盜竊超過800件未售出的Chanel手袋及銀包，總值至少870萬元，被判監禁最長七年。
高等法院就兩宗未遂盜竊案判刑，案件涉及2016年6月至2017年2月期間針對法國時裝品牌在青衣Goodman Interlink貨倉的儲存空間。涉案貨品為2014-15年度過季商品，按品牌政策本應銷毀以維持產品獨特性。
倉庫主管吳耀倫（42歲）向同黨透露Chanel職員使用的升降機密碼。包括何東山（35歲）及何子賢（41歲）在內的同黨於2016年試圖盜竊約90個手袋，將其藏起而非按程序銷毀。保安其後發現貨品，但最初未有報警。第二宗圖謀同樣被截獲。
